item.name: A. RUN ALL - FR-08 API (bấm Send, chạy 30+ ca)

exec: // ===== FR-08 (Thanh toán - Checkout) - TẦNG API - FULL SUITE (38 ca) ======
(async () => {
const BASE = pm.collectionVariables.get('baseUrl') || 'http://localhost:3000';
const USER1 = { email: pm.collectionVariables.get('userEmail') || 'test@eshop.com', password: pm.collectionVariables.get('userPassword') || 'Test1234!' };
const USER2 = { email: pm.collectionVariables.get('userEmail2') || 'user2@eshop.com', password: pm.collectionVariables.get('userPassword2') || 'Password123!' };
const R = [];
const rec = (id, desc, verdict, note) => R.push({ id, desc, verdict, note: note || '' });
const call = (method, path, body, token) => new Promise((resolve) => {
const opt = { url: BASE + path, method, header: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' } };
if (token) opt.header['Authorization'] = 'Bearer ' + token;
if (body !== undefined) opt.body = { mode: 'raw', raw: JSON.stringify(body) };
pm.sendRequest(opt, (err, res) => {
if (err || !res) return resolve({ code: 0, json: null, text: String(err) });
let j = null; try { j = res.json(); } catch (e) {}
resolve({ code: res.code, json: j, text: res.text() });
const short = (r) => `HTTP ${r.code} ${String(r.text).slice(0, 80).replace(/\s+/g, ' ')}`;
const login = async (email, password) => {
let r = await call('POST', '/api/login', { email, password });
if (!r.json || !r.json.token) {
await call('POST', '/api/register', { name: 'User Two', email, password });
r = await call('POST', '/api/login', { email, password });
return { r, token: r.json && r.json.token };
const u1 = await login(USER1.email, USER1.password);
const u2 = await login(USER2.email, USER2.password);
if (!u1.token) {
pm.test('SETUP LỖI: không đăng nhập được user mẫu', () => { throw new Error('setup'); });
return;
const U1 = u1.token, U2 = u2.token || U1, BADTOKEN = 'invalid.bearer.token';
const prodsRes = await call('GET', '/api/products');
const prods = Array.isArray(prodsRes.json) ? prodsRes.json : [];
if (!prods.length) {
pm.test('SETUP LỖI: chưa có sản phẩm nào', () => { throw new Error('setup'); });
return;
const P1 = prods[0], P2 = prods[1] || prods[0];
const prepareCart = async (items) => {
for (const item of items) {
await call('POST', '/api/cart', item, U1);
const getCart = async (token) => {
const r = await call('GET', '/api/cart', undefined, token || U1);
return Array.isArray(r.json) ? r.json : [];
// === 1. HEADER AUTHORIZATION (DT-01 .. DT-06) ===
await prepareCart([{ id: P1.id, name: P1.name, price: Number(P1.price) || 100000, quantity: 2 }]);
const r1 = await call('POST', '/api/checkout', { total_amount: 200000, shipping_address: '123 Le Loi' }, U1);
const cAfter1 = await getCart(U1);
rec('DT-01', 'C1.1 - Baseline: Checkout với Token chuẩn', (is2(r1.code) && cAfter1.length === 0) ? 'PASS' : 'FAIL', `${short(r1)} | giỏ còn=${cAfter1.length}`);
await prepareCart([{ id: P1.id, name: P1.name, price: 100000, quantity: 1 }]);
const r2 = await call('POST', '/api/checkout', { total_amount: 100000, shipping_address: '123 Le Loi' }, undefined);
rec('DT-02', 'C1.2 - Thiếu Header Authorization', is4(r2.code) ? 'PASS' : 'FAIL', short(r2));
const r3 = await call('POST', '/api/checkout', { total_amount: 100000, shipping_address: '123 Le Loi' }, 'eyJhbGciOi...');
rec('DT-03', 'C1.3 - Header thiếu tiền tố Bearer', is4(r3.code) ? 'PASS' : 'FAIL', short(r3));
const r4 = await call('POST', '/api/checkout', { total_amount: 100000, shipping_address: '123 Le Loi' }, 'invalid_sig');
rec('DT-04', 'C1.4 - Token chữ ký không hợp lệ', is4(r4.code) ? 'PASS' : 'FAIL', short(r4));
const r5 = await call('POST', '/api/checkout', { total_amount: 100000, shipping_address: '123 Le Loi' }, 'expired_jwt_token');
rec('DT-05', 'C1.5 - Token đã hết hạn', is4(r5.code) ? 'PASS' : 'FAIL', short(r5));
const r6 = await call('POST', '/api/checkout', { total_amount: 100000, shipping_address: '123 Le Loi' }, 'revoked_token');
rec('DT-06', 'C1.6 - Token tài khoản bị khóa/logout', 'CLARIFY', `${short(r6)} (SRS im lặng)`);
await prepareCart([{ id: P1.id, name: P1.name, price: 100000, quantity: 2 }]);
const r7 = await call('POST', '/api/checkout', { total_amount: 200000, shipping_address: '123 Le Loi' }, U1);
rec('DT-07', 'C2.1 - total_amount khớp giỏ hàng (200,000)', is2(r7.code) ? 'PASS' : 'FAIL', short(r7));
await prepareCart([{ id: P1.id, name: P1.name, price: 100000, quantity: 2 }]);
const r8 = await call('POST', '/api/checkout', { total_amount: 0, shipping_address: '123 Le Loi' }, U1);
const oList8 = await call('GET', '/api/orders/my-orders', undefined, U1);
const last8 = Array.isArray(oList8.json) && oList8.json.length ? oList8.json[oList8.json.length - 1] : null;
const ok8 = is2(r8.code) && last8 && Number(last8.total_amount) === 200000;
rec('DT-08', 'C2.2 - total_amount client gửi sai (0) -> Backend tự tính lại', ok8 ? 'PASS' : 'FAIL', `${short(r8)} | DB lưu=${last8 ? last8.total_amount : 'n/a'}`);
await prepareCart([{ id: P1.id, name: P1.name, price: 100000, quantity: 1 }]);
const r9 = await call('POST', '/api/checkout', { total_amount: '200000', shipping_address: '123 Le Loi' }, U1);
rec('DT-09', 'C2.3 - total_amount sai kiểu String', is4(r9.code) ? 'PASS' : 'FAIL', short(r9));
const r10 = await call('POST', '/api/checkout', { total_amount: -100000, shipping_address: '123 Le Loi' }, U1);
rec('DT-10', 'C2.4 / BV-01 - total_amount số âm (-100000)', 'CLARIFY', `${short(r10)} (SRS im lặng)`);
const r11 = await call('POST', '/api/checkout', { total_amount: null, shipping_address: '123 Le Loi' }, U1);
rec('DT-11', 'C2.5 - total_amount truyền null/thiếu', 'CLARIFY', `${short(r11)} (SRS im lặng)`);
await prepareCart([{ id: P1.id, name: P1.name, price: 1, quantity: 1 }]);
const rBv3 = await call('POST', '/api/checkout', { total_amount: 1, shipping_address: '123 Le Loi' }, U1);
rec('BV-03', 'total_amount = 1 (In-point số dương nhỏ nhất)', is2(rBv3.code) ? 'PASS' : 'FAIL', short(rBv3));
// === 3. SHIPPING_ADDRESS (DT-12 .. DT-18, BV-04..09) ===
await prepareCart([{ id: P1.id, name: P1.name, price: 100000, quantity: 1 }]);
const r12 = await call('POST', '/api/checkout', { total_amount: 100000, shipping_address: '123 Le Loi, TP.HCM' }, U1);
rec('DT-12', 'C3.1 - shipping_address văn bản chuẩn', is2(r12.code) ? 'PASS' : 'FAIL', short(r12));
await prepareCart([{ id: P1.id, name: P1.name, price: 100000, quantity: 1 }]);
const r13 = await call('POST', '/api/checkout', { total_amount: 100000, shipping_address: "<script>alert('XSS')</script>" }, U1);
rec('DT-13', 'C3.2 - shipping_address chứa script HTML/JS (SEC-04)', is2(r13.code) ? 'PASS' : 'FAIL', short(r13));
await prepareCart([{ id: P1.id, name: P1.name, price: 100000, quantity: 1 }]);
const r14 = await call('POST', '/api/checkout', { total_amount: 100000, shipping_address: 12345 }, U1);
rec('DT-14', 'C3.3 - shipping_address sai kiểu Number', is4(r14.code) ? 'PASS' : 'FAIL', short(r14));
const r15 = await call('POST', '/api/checkout', { total_amount: 100000, shipping_address: '' }, U1);
rec('DT-15', 'C3.4 / BV-04 - shipping_address rỗng ""', 'CLARIFY', `${short(r15)} (SRS im lặng)`);
const r16 = await call('POST', '/api/checkout', { total_amount: 100000, shipping_address: '   ' }, U1);
rec('DT-16', 'C3.5 - shipping_address chỉ chứa khoảng trắng', 'CLARIFY', `${short(r16)} (SRS im lặng)`);
const r17 = await call('POST', '/api/checkout', { total_amount: 100000, shipping_address: null }, U1);
rec('DT-17', 'C3.6 - shipping_address null/thiếu', 'CLARIFY', `${short(r17)} (SRS im lặng)`);
await prepareCart([{ id: P1.id, name: P1.name, price: 100000, quantity: 1 }]);
const rBv5 = await call('POST', '/api/checkout', { total_amount: 100000, shipping_address: 'A' }, U1);
rec('BV-05', 'shipping_address 1 ký tự (Biên dưới Min)', is2(rBv5.code) ? 'PASS' : 'FAIL', short(rBv5));
await prepareCart([{ id: P1.id, name: P1.name, price: 100000, quantity: 1 }]);
const rBv8 = await call('POST', '/api/checkout', { total_amount: 100000, shipping_address: 'A'.repeat(255) }, U1);
rec('BV-08', 'shipping_address 255 ký tự (Biên trên Max)', 'CLARIFY', `${short(rBv8)} (SRS im lặng)`);
const r18 = await call('POST', '/api/checkout', { total_amount: 100000, shipping_address: 'A'.repeat(1000) }, U1);
rec('DT-18', 'C3.7 / BV-09 - shipping_address 1000 ký tự', 'CLARIFY', `${short(r18)} (SRS im lặng)`);
// === 4. CART INPUTS: QUANTITY & PRICE (DT-19 .. DT-27, BV-10..18) ===
const r19 = await call('POST', '/api/cart', { id: P1.id, name: P1.name, price: 100000, quantity: 2 }, U1);
rec('DT-19', 'C4.1 - Thêm vào giỏ với quantity hợp lệ (2)', is2(r19.code) ? 'PASS' : 'FAIL', short(r19));
const r20 = await call('POST', '/api/cart', { id: P1.id, name: P1.name, price: 100000, quantity: '2' }, U1);
rec('DT-20', 'C4.2 - quantity sai kiểu String "2"', is4(r20.code) ? 'PASS' : 'FAIL', short(r20));
const r21 = await call('POST', '/api/cart', { id: P1.id, name: P1.name, price: 100000, quantity: 0 }, U1);
rec('DT-21', 'C4.3 / BV-10 - quantity bằng 0', 'CLARIFY', `${short(r21)} (SRS im lặng)`);
const r22 = await call('POST', '/api/cart', { id: P1.id, name: P1.name, price: 100000, quantity: -1 }, U1);
rec('DT-22', 'C4.4 - quantity số âm (-1)', 'CLARIFY', `${short(r22)} (SRS im lặng)`);
const r23 = await call('POST', '/api/cart', { id: P1.id, name: P1.name, price: 100000, quantity: 999999 }, U1);
rec('DT-23', 'C4.5 / BV-15 - quantity cực lớn (999999)', 'CLARIFY', `${short(r23)} (SRS im lặng)`);
const r24 = await call('POST', '/api/cart', { id: P1.id, name: P1.name, price: 100000, quantity: 1 }, U1);
rec('DT-24', 'C5.1 - Thêm vào giỏ với price hợp lệ', is2(r24.code) ? 'PASS' : 'FAIL', short(r24));
const r25 = await call('POST', '/api/cart', { id: P1.id, name: P1.name, price: '100000', quantity: 1 }, U1);
rec('DT-25', 'C5.2 - price sai kiểu String', is4(r25.code) ? 'PASS' : 'FAIL', short(r25));
const r26 = await call('POST', '/api/cart', { id: P1.id, name: P1.name, price: 0, quantity: 1 }, U1);
rec('DT-26', 'C5.3 / BV-16 - price bằng 0', 'CLARIFY', `${short(r26)} (SRS im lặng)`);
const r27 = await call('POST', '/api/cart', { id: P1.id, name: P1.name, price: -50000, quantity: 1 }, U1);
rec('DT-27', 'C5.4 - price số âm (-50000)', 'CLARIFY', `${short(r27)} (SRS im lặng)`);
// === 5. CART STATE & CHECKOUT (DT-28 .. DT-30) ===
await prepareCart([{ id: P1.id, name: P1.name, price: 100000, quantity: 1 }]);
const r28 = await call('POST', '/api/checkout', { total_amount: 100000, shipping_address: '123 Le Loi' }, U1);
rec('DT-28', 'C6.1 - Checkout giỏ hàng có 1 sản phẩm', is2(r28.code) ? 'PASS' : 'FAIL', short(r28));
const r29 = await call('POST', '/api/checkout', { total_amount: 0, shipping_address: '123 Le Loi' }, U1);
rec('DT-29', 'C6.2 - Checkout giỏ hàng rỗng (0 sản phẩm)', 'CLARIFY', `${short(r29)} (SRS im lặng)`);
// === 6. ACCESS CONTROL (AC-01 .. AC-05) ===
const ac1 = await call('POST', '/api/checkout', { total_amount: 100000, shipping_address: '123 Le Loi' });
rec('AC-01', 'Checkout khi chưa đăng nhập (không token)', is4(ac1.code) ? 'PASS' : 'FAIL', short(ac1));
const ac2 = await call('GET', '/api/cart');
rec('AC-02', 'Lấy giỏ hàng khi chưa đăng nhập (không token)', is4(ac2.code) ? 'PASS' : 'FAIL', short(ac2));
const ac3 = await call('POST', '/api/cart', { id: P1.id, name: P1.name, price: 100000, quantity: 1 });
rec('AC-03', 'Thêm vào giỏ hàng khi chưa đăng nhập (không token)', is4(ac3.code) ? 'PASS' : 'FAIL', short(ac3));
const ac4 = await call('GET', '/api/orders/my-orders');
rec('AC-04', 'Xem lịch sử đơn hàng khi chưa đăng nhập (không token)', is4(ac4.code) ? 'PASS' : 'FAIL', short(ac4));
const ac5 = await call('POST', '/api/checkout', { total_amount: 100000, shipping_address: '123 Le Loi' }, BADTOKEN);
rec('AC-05', 'Checkout với Token hỏng/hết hạn', is4(ac5.code) ? 'PASS' : 'FAIL', short(ac5));
// === 7. BUSINESS LOGIC & SIDE-EFFECTS (BL-01 .. BL-09) ===
await prepareCart([{ id: P1.id, name: P1.name, price: 150000, quantity: 2 }]);
const rBl1 = await call('POST', '/api/checkout', { total_amount: 1, shipping_address: '123 Le Loi' }, U1);
const oBl1 = await call('GET', '/api/orders/my-orders', undefined, U1);
const lastBl1 = Array.isArray(oBl1.json) && oBl1.json.length ? oBl1.json[oBl1.json.length - 1] : null;
const okBl1 = is2(rBl1.code) && lastBl1 && Number(lastBl1.total_amount) === 300000;
rec('BL-01', 'Backend tự tính total_amount = 300k, bỏ qua 1đ client truyền', okBl1 ? 'PASS' : 'FAIL', `${short(rBl1)} | DB lưu=${lastBl1 ? lastBl1.total_amount : 'n/a'}`);
await prepareCart([{ id: P1.id, name: P1.name, price: 100000, quantity: 1 }]);
const rBl2 = await call('POST', '/api/checkout', { total_amount: 100000, shipping_address: '123 Le Loi' }, U1);
const cartBl2 = await getCart(U1);
rec('BL-02', 'Giỏ hàng bị xóa sạch sau khi checkout thành công (R5)', (is2(rBl2.code) && cartBl2.length === 0) ? 'PASS' : 'FAIL', `${short(rBl2)} | giỏ còn=${cartBl2.length}`);
await prepareCart([{ id: P1.id, name: P1.name, price: 100000, quantity: 1 }]);
const rBl3 = await call('POST', '/api/checkout', { total_amount: 100000, shipping_address: '123 Le Loi' }, BADTOKEN);
const cartBl3 = await getCart(U1);
rec('BL-03', 'Giỏ hàng KHÔNG bị xóa khi checkout thất bại', (is4(rBl3.code) && cartBl3.length > 0) ? 'PASS' : 'FAIL', `${short(rBl3)} | giỏ còn=${cartBl3.length}`);
await prepareCart([{ id: P1.id, name: P1.name, price: 100000, quantity: 1 }]);
const coBl5 = await call('POST', '/api/checkout', { total_amount: 100000, shipping_address: 'User 1 Address' }, U1);
const oU1 = await call('GET', '/api/orders/my-orders', undefined, U1);
const oU2 = await call('GET', '/api/orders/my-orders', undefined, U2);
const listU1 = Array.isArray(oU1.json) ? oU1.json : [];
const listU2 = Array.isArray(oU2.json) ? oU2.json : [];
const lastU1 = listU1[listU1.length - 1];
const leaked = !!lastU1 && listU2.some(o => o.id === lastU1.id);
rec('BL-05', 'Cách ly dữ liệu đơn hàng (User 2 không thấy đơn User 1)', !leaked ? 'PASS' : 'FAIL', `${short(coBl5)} | rò rỉ=${leaked}`);
// BÁO CÁO
const cnt = { PASS: 0, FAIL: 0, CLARIFY: 0 };
R.forEach(x => cnt[x.verdict]++);
pm.test(`TỔNG ${R.length} ca (FR-08 API): PASS ${cnt.PASS} | FAIL ${cnt.FAIL} | CẦN LÀM RÕ ${cnt.CLARIFY}`, () => {});
R.forEach(x => {
if (x.verdict === 'CLARIFY') pm.test(`[CẦN LÀM RÕ] ${x.id} | ${x.desc} | ${x.note}`, () => {});
else pm.test(`${x.id} | ${x.desc} | ${x.note}`, () => { pm.expect(x.verdict === 'PASS', x.note).to.be.true; });
console.log('FR-08 API: ' + JSON.stringify(cnt));
const cell = (s) => String(s).replace(/\|/g, '/').replace(/\s+/g, ' ');
const md = [`Chạy lúc: ${new Date().toISOString()} | baseUrl: ${BASE} | PASS ${cnt.PASS} | FAIL ${cnt.FAIL} | CẦN LÀM RÕ ${cnt.CLARIFY}`, '',
.concat(R.map(x => `| ${x.id} | ${cell(x.desc)} | ${x.verdict} | ${cell(x.note)} |`)).join('\n');
console.log(md);
try {
pm.visualizer.set(`<style>body{font-family:sans-serif;font-size:13px}td,th{border:1px solid #ccc;padding:4px 8px;text-align:left}
.PASS{background:#dcfce7}.FAIL{background:#fee2e2}.CLARIFY{background:#fef9c3}</style>
FR-08 tầng API: PASS {{c.PASS}} | FAIL {{c.FAIL}} | CẦN LÀM RÕ {{c.CLARIFY}}
Báo cáo Markdown (bấm vào ô, Ctrl+A, Ctrl+C):
<textarea readonly rows="8" style="width:100%" onclick="this.select()">{{md}}</textarea>
<table><tr><th>ID</th><th>Mô tả</th><th>Verdict</th><th>Quan sát</th></tr>
{{#each r}}{{id}}{{desc}}{{verdict}}{{note}}{{/each}}`,
{ r: R, c: cnt, md });
} catch (e) {}

item.name: B. Tái hiện bug để chụp ảnh (Send lần lượt từ trên xuống)
B0. CHUẨN BỊ (chạy trước): user token, user2 token, sản phẩm mẫu & giỏ hàng mồi

exec: const base = pm.collectionVariables.get('baseUrl');
const send = (method, path, body, token) => new Promise(res => pm.sendRequest({
url: base + path, method, header: Object.assign({'Content-Type': 'application/json'}, token ? {Authorization: 'Bearer ' + token} : {}),
body: body ? {mode: 'raw', raw: JSON.stringify(body)} : undefined }, (e, r) => res(r)));
(async () => {
const j = (r) => { try { return r.json(); } catch (e) { return null; } };
const set = (k, v) => pm.collectionVariables.set(k, String(v));
const mark = 'FR8BUG-' + Date.now().toString(36);
set('bugMark', mark);
let u1 = j(await send('POST', '/api/login', {email: pm.collectionVariables.get('userEmail'), password: pm.collectionVariables.get('userPassword')})) || {};
let u2 = j(await send('POST', '/api/login', {email: pm.collectionVariables.get('userEmail2'), password: pm.collectionVariables.get('userPassword2')})) || {};
if (!u2.token) {
await send('POST', '/api/register', {name: 'User Two', email: pm.collectionVariables.get('userEmail2'), password: pm.collectionVariables.get('userPassword2')});
u2 = j(await send('POST', '/api/login', {email: pm.collectionVariables.get('userEmail2'), password: pm.collectionVariables.get('userPassword2')})) || {};
set('userToken', u1.token || ''); set('userToken2', u2.token || '');
const prods = j(await send('GET', '/api/products')) || [];
if (prods.length > 0) {
set('prodId1', prods[0].id); set('prodPrice1', prods[0].price);
if (prods.length > 1) {
set('prodId2', prods[1].id); set('prodPrice2', prods[1].price);
} else if (prods.length > 0) {
set('prodId2', prods[0].id); set('prodPrice2', prods[0].price);
// Setup giỏ hàng ban đầu cho user 1
if (u1.token && prods.length > 0) {
await send('POST', '/api/cart', {id: prods[0].id, name: prods[0].name, price: Number(prods[0].price) || 100000, quantity: 2}, u1.token);
const cv = (k) => pm.collectionVariables.get(k);
pm.test('Chuẩn bị xong: đợt ' + cv('bugMark') + ', userToken=' + (cv('userToken') ? 'OK' : 'THIẾU') + ', prodId1=' + cv('prodId1'), () => {
pm.expect(cv('userToken'), 'không đăng nhập được user').to.not.be.empty;
pm.expect(cv('prodId1'), 'không lấy được sản phẩm mẫu').to.not.be.empty;

item.name: FR-08-BUG-01c. Đọc lại: kiểm tra không có đơn hàng rác nào được tạo trái phép

exec: const mark = pm.collectionVariables.get('bugMark');
const orders = pm.response.json();
